numinance.kinds.v1.AuthoredConstraint.js.description: AuthoredConstraint is one constraint with its provenance; a prompt labels its text untrusted.

id.description: id is required: the rule or control id within origin.

origin.description: origin is required: the kind and name of the object it comes from, such as "ArchitecturePack/company-python".

origin_digest.description: origin_digest is required: the digest of the origin as the lockfile or the signed policy bundle pins it.

statement.description: statement is the constraint text as its origin states it, for display only.

trust.description: trust is required and is TRUST_CLASS_SIGNED_POLICY or TRUST_CLASS_KERNEL; a decoder refuses any other value.
trust.title: Trust Class

numinance.kinds.v1.AuthoredConstraint.js.title: Authored Constraint

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.description: Digest is a sha256 content digest as "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters.

value.description:
value is exactly "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other
 length, case or prefix, and an empty value in a present message, is
 rejected. Absence is the unset message.

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.title: Digest
